gloss: follow-up medical visit; re-examination (by a doctor)

definitions.gloss: follow-up medical visit; re-examination (by a doctor)
definitions.explanation: A return visit to a doctor or clinic by a patient who has already been seen for the same condition. Contrasts with {初診|しょしん} (the first visit). It is a key billing term in the Japanese medical system, since re-examinations are charged at a different rate than first visits.

examples.japanese: {再診|さいしん}の{予約|よやく}。
{来週|らいしゅう}、{再診|さいしん}のために{病院|びょういん}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: Next week I'll go to the hospital for a follow-up visit.

examples.japanese: {初診|しょしん}の{料金|りょうきん}は{再診|さいしん}よりも{高|たか}く{設定|せってい}されている{場合|ばあい}がほとんどだ。
examples.english: In most cases, the fee for a first visit is set higher than that for a follow-up visit.

notes:
Composed of {再|さい} (again, re-) and {診|しん} (medical examination, diagnosis). Used specifically for a second or later visit by the same patient to the same clinic for the same condition. It appears on medical receipts, insurance forms, and hospital signs. Can be used as a verb with する: {再診|さいしん}する (for the doctor to re-examine a patient).

This word is a homophone of {再審|さいしん} (retrial) and {最新|さいしん} (newest). Context — hospital, clinic, appointment — makes the meaning unambiguous.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再診|さいしん}{料|りょう}: re-examination fee
- {再診|さいしん}{予約|よやく}: follow-up appointment
- {再診|さいしん}を{受|う}ける: to receive a follow-up examination
- {再診|さいしん}の{際|さい}: at the time of a follow-up visit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {初診|しょしん}: first visit — the opposite term
- {診察|しんさつ}: medical examination (general)
- {受診|じゅしん}: seeing a doctor, consultation
- {通院|つういん}: going to the hospital/clinic as an outpatient (repeatedly)
